observed: plan spine reports three open 0.11.2 nodes created by the core, but report -cached still selects legacy PLAN step 93 Hermes as next work. The node thread and report.Next disagree.
expected: When open plan nodes exist, report/curator status exposes the active node thread as current machine-readable work instead of an unrelated legacy markdown step.
evidence: SRVLM01 2026-09-29: open nodes N-001/N-002/N-003; report.next=93 Hermes.
reproduction: Create open nodes with air-worker plan node new, then compare plan spine -json with report -product <root> -cached -json next.
workaround: Use plan spine/node list explicitly and do not trust report.next while node thread is non-empty.
proposed_outcome: Unify report.Next with plan-node spine and preserve legacy PLAN fallback only when no open nodes exist.
